title: The Third Turn
lines: Meg and Kurt run up the cold hill.
They have one sled, so they must take turns.
Meg gets the first turn on the sled.
Then Kurt gets his turn on it.
He bumps a rock and lands in the dirt.
Dirt is all on his shirt and hands.
Kurt curls up for a bit and sits still.
Meg tugs at the rock, but it is stuck.
Then Kurt sets his red cap on the rock.
Meg can spot the red cap from the hill.
Kurt gets a third turn and misses the rock.
He grins and hands the sled back to Meg.

questions.ask: Why did Meg and Kurt have to take turns?
questions.listenFor: They had just one sled. It is in the second line.

questions.ask: What did Kurt do so they could spot the rock?
questions.listenFor: He set his red cap on top of it. Meg had tugged at the rock first, but it was stuck.

questions.ask: Which turn was the best one to read about? Read me that bit.
questions.listenFor: Any of the three. Kurt's third turn, when he misses the rock, is a common pick.
